channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Beyond Smoking
item.description: Nicotine's future may extend beyond its traditional role as a smoking cessation aid. As cigarette use declines, a growing market for smoke-free nicotine products raises questions about consumer choice, regulation and the long-term place of nicotine in society. (Published on November 04, 2026bycenterforglobalhealthaccountability.org)

item.title: Time for a research priorities reset
item.description: Smoking-related deaths in the United States remain concentrated among older adults, yet this population receives comparatively little attention in tobacco control research. (Published on November 05, 2026bymedium.com)

item.title: US FDA Rethinks the Continuum of Risk
item.description: The US FDA is signalling a shift towards recognising the continuum of risk in tobacco and nicotine regulation. (Published on November 05, 2026bytobaccoasia.com)

item.title: FDA Signals PMTA Overhaul, But Will It Deliver?
item.description: The FDA's proposed overhaul of its Premarket Tobacco Product Application (PMTA) process has renewed hopes for a more predictable regulatory pathway for vaping products in the United States. (Published on November 05, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)

item.title: Vapes and Quitting Smoking: The Facts May Surprise You
item.description: Nicotine vaping can help adults quit smoking, but successful tobacco harm reduction involves more than simply replacing one product with another. (Published on November 05, 2026byyonkerstimes.com)
